articles.title: Silver prices crash ₹8,500/kg, gold drops ₹2,000/10g as US-Iran tensions revive inflation fears; is more fall ahead?
articles.description: Silver futures fell to the lowest level since late November 2025, erasing Monday’s gains as reports of a US strike on Iran sent oil prices higher and revived inflation concerns. Gold also declined, while investors weighed interest-rate expectations, US midterm elections and an upcoming jobs report.

articles.title: Rupee nudges higher, forward premiums dip with focus on US midterm, oil moves
articles.description: On Tuesday, the Indian rupee gained slightly against the dollar, closing at 94.74 per dollar. This change occurred as investors awaited the results of the US midterm elections and developments in the Iran war. Oil prices rebounded, raising concerns about potential impacts on energy supplies. Analysts suggest that potential outcomes from the elections could influence the dollar's short-term position.

articles.title: Kerosene costlier than petrol: Karnataka fishermen switches fuel, but 95% of boats still out of water
articles.description: Rising kerosene prices and expensive petrol alternatives are forcing traditional nadadoni fishermen along Karnatakas coast to suspend boat operations. Fishermen in Dakshina Kannada estimate that 90% to 95% of boats have stopped operating, while operators in Uttara Kannada report a sharp decline in deep-sea fishing and are seeking government subsidies and clarity on alternative fuel arrangements.
